name: experience-golden
description: Hand-built cases testing Experience Reuse Rate: does a recorded lesson resurface via recommendForTask() for a later, genuinely related task (expectReuse: true), and does it correctly stay out of an unrelated one (expectReuse: false, the false-reuse control)? Scenarios are dev-agent failure modes, the beachhead the roadmap discussion favored.

prior.action: Ran npm install with Node 16 installed locally
prior.lesson: This project requires Node 20+ — npm install fails on peer dependency resolution under Node 16 with a confusing ERESOLVE error instead of a clear version mismatch message.

cases.laterTask: Set this project up on a freshly reinstalled machine

prior.action: Ran the deploy script without setting DATABASE_URL in the production environment
prior.lesson: The deploy script does not validate required environment variables before starting the app, so a missing DATABASE_URL surfaces as a generic connection timeout minutes into the deploy instead of failing fast at startup.

cases.laterTask: Push the latest changes live to the production server

prior.task: Build the Docker image for release
prior.action: Ran docker build without passing the required BUILD_VERSION argument
prior.lesson: The Dockerfile has no default for BUILD_VERSION, so omitting --build-arg BUILD_VERSION=... fails the build at the version-stamping step with an unhelpful empty-string error.

cases.laterTask: Build a new Docker image for the upcoming release

prior.action: Ran the migration command while the app's connection pool still had open transactions
prior.lesson: Migrations against this database hang waiting for a table lock if the app's own connection pool has any open transactions — stop the app (or drain its pool) before migrating, not after starting the migration.

cases.laterTask: Apply the new database migrations before this week's release

prior.task: Debug why API requests started failing with 401 errors
prior.action: Checked the API client's stored credentials
prior.lesson: The API client caches its auth token for 24 hours client-side but the server actually expires it after 12 — refreshing the token proactively at the 12-hour mark, not on first 401, avoids the failure window.

cases.laterTask: Investigate intermittent 401 responses from the API in the automation pipeline

prior.task: Merge the feature branch into main
prior.action: Resolved a merge conflict by taking the feature branch's version of the config file wholesale
prior.lesson: The config file has environment-specific values on both sides of a merge conflict — taking either side wholesale silently drops the other environment's settings; conflicts in this file need a manual field-by-field merge, not a pick-one resolution.

cases.laterTask: Merge the latest release branch into main before the deploy
